Done. Implemented all three functions:

- **clamp(n, min, max)** in src/num.js: returns n constrained to [min, max] using Math.min/max
- **formatBytes(n)** in src/util.js: converts byte counts to B/KB/MB/GB with one decimal place
- **slugify(title)** in src/text.js: lowercases, trims, replaces space runs with dashes, and removes non-alphanumeric characters (keeping dashes)

All are exported from their respective modules.
